name: Sandstep the Tawny Cat
blurb: Sandstep, a lean tawny shorthair with a cream chest, dark-tipped tail and gold-brown eyes, pads across the little garden footbridge every dusk.

name: Cloudleap the Striped Cat
blurb: Cloudleap, a bright orange mackerel tabby with bold dark stripes, a white chin and gold eyes, springs over the garden hedges in one bound.

name: Shutterpaw the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Shutterpaw, a sleek black-and-white tuxedo cat with a white face blaze and green eyes, poses for one quick photo, then slips behind the hedge.
